user.title: Dual setpoint
user.description: Pick the single-setpoint climate entity to wrap. It must support both heat and cool.

data.min_gap: Minimum gap between the low and high setpoints
data.min_cycle_time: Minimum time between heat and cool changes

data_description.min_gap: Keep this comfortably larger than your thermostat's overshoot, or the unit will heat and cool against itself.
data_description.min_cycle_time: How long the wrapper waits before flipping between heating and cooling.
data_description.coordinate_modes: For indoor units sharing one outdoor unit: the group conditions one direction at a time, and units on the losing side are held off (or fan only) until their turn. Their cards keep showing your mode and report idle.
data_description.coordination_group: Wrappers that share the same group name run on one outdoor unit and take turns.
data_description.coordination_priority: Breaks ties when zones claim the outdoor unit at the same time; higher wins. 0 suits most homes.
data_description.thwarted_heat_hold: What this unit is parked to while the group is cooling instead of heating: off, or fan only.
data_description.thwarted_cool_hold: What this unit is parked to while the group is heating instead of cooling: off, or fan only.
data_description.thwarted_fan_mode: Optional fan speed (named as your source names them) applied while parked in fan only. Leave empty to keep the unit's own fan speed.

error.source_not_found: That entity does not exist yet.
error.source_not_dual: That climate entity does not support both heat and cool.

abort.already_configured: That climate entity is already wrapped.
abort.circular: A Dual Setpoint Climate entity cannot wrap another one.

gap_too_small.message: The low and high setpoints must be at least {min_gap} {unit} apart. Widen them, or lower the minimum gap in the integration options.
